purpose: Specifications to implement and execute through real code. Not executable app tests or test results by themselves.

gates.G0: Baseline inspection and exact owner-trace attribution when accessible
gates.G2: Registered tools, input/output validation and both bridge serializers
gates.G3: Executed browser and real UI callbacks, with controlled external adapters
gates.G4: Isolated real local durable persistence across process restart
gates.G5: Exact-candidate full suite, build, release, privacy and security
gates.G7: Separately authorized live source/model output and quality
gates.G8: Conditionally authorized private preview publication and readback

cases.title: Actual 2020 year-only button journey
steps: Populate the real Screen 2 form using FX01; choose ordinary year, enter 2020 and leave threshold disabled.
Click Continue to comparison guidance through each actual supported bridge and registered handler.
Read the committed operation and return/reopen the same study.
assertions: Immediate visible acknowledgement; duplicate submission disabled.
One logical handoff receipt and one intended scientific save.
Saved year is numeric 2020 at year precision; no threshold, legal date or method decision is invented.
Screen 3 renders compatible conditional guidance and a distinct not-generated model critique.
No model dispatch and no new source retrieval is triggered by this handoff.
Submitted study/identity/evidence fields survive exactly.

evidence_required: Exact candidate commit/tree or clearly identified tested worktree
Actual test/handler path and executed command or authorized manual procedure
Terminal result and safe log/screenshot/receipt reference
Scoped model/source dispatch counts and any untested variants
